text:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] PROD eu-north-1 - regional-health failover alert: sustained cross-region shift > 15% for 6m (traffic moving to eu-south) - paging oncall

morgan lee: got the page. p95 eu-north spiking to ~1.4s, p99 to ~2.8s. errors small but visible (0.4%). no deploys in last 30m per ci-bot. linking dashboard: https://console.redwood/dashboards/regional-health?view=eun

tarun patel: i'm oncall and taking lead. @elena can you pull recent cron jobs and cache invalidation schedules? suspecting stale cache sweep.

elena garcia: checking. I see a scheduled cache-recompute job at 11:07 for model-kv in eu-north that did a full keyspace touch. logs show heavy fanout and increased KV latencies starting 11:08.

kai wong: infra note: a few serving nodes reported high syscall wait during the window, and one node started evicting local caches. that could explain increased backend_kv miss rate.

tarun patel: mitigation plan: 1) throttle the cache-recompute job (pause full sweep), 2) shift 30% traffic to eu-south for 15m to relieve tail, 3) temporarily silence regional failover alert (avoid noisy paging), 4) enable conservative routing (prefer pools with recent healthy synth checks).

ops-bot: runbook.execute: pause-cron job cache-recompute-eun -> SUCCESS (job-id: cron-233445-01)

ci-bot: deploy-check: no in-flight deploys.

ops-bot: runbook.execute: shift-traffic eu-south weight +30% -> SUCCESS (route-change-id rc-233445-07)

incidents-bot: Alert suppressed: regional-health-failover (eu-north-1) muted for 25m by tarun patel (temp threshold raised + route suppression).

morgan lee: after traffic shift p95 eu-north dropped from 1.4s -> 480ms, p99 to ~820ms. eu-south p95 rose slightly but synth canaries green. good immediate containment.

elena garcia: cache job telemetry: the recompute was touching large result-sets for certain client_ids that generate many small keys. adding per-client backoff will help. I'll push a hotfix to the job to limit concurrency to 8 per worker.

kai wong: we should also add an alert that pairs cross-region shift with p99 latency so autoscaler/noisy-cron churn doesn't spam pages. example: fire when (cross_region_delta > 15% for 5m) AND (p99 > 700ms for 5m).

tarun patel: +1. also add min-sample filter and exclude events within 10m of scheduled cron runs. we can use metric tag cron.window to suppress during known sweeps.

ops-bot: runbook.step: create-monitor combined-failover-latency -> SUCCESS (mon-id m-233445-cf)

morgan lee: customer impact: a few mid-size customers in EU experienced elevated latency but no data loss. support logged ticket #4763 and CSMs notified.

elena garcia: patch for recompute job submitted: https://repo.redwood/infra/cron/pulls/77 (limits concurrency + adds jitter). deploy in 10m once approved.

tarun patel: handoff plan: i'll be on for 18 more minutes. if p99 > 900ms or cross-region shift > 20% reopen page. otherwise handoff to morgan for monitoring and post-incident.

incidents-bot: Update: p95 eu-north stabilizing ~420-520ms; p99 trending down to ~600ms. eu-south stable.

kai wong: post-incident action suggestions: 1) new dashboard panel for route-weight history with annotations for cron/deploy/autoscaler events, 2) alert tuning to combine shift+latency with min-samples, 3) synth canary per region and per routing-pool, 4) automatic tagging of alerts when cron windows overlap (so ops knows why it fired).

morgan lee: I'll own dashboards and the synth job creation. tarun, elena, kai take infra/cron fixes and alert PRs. I'll file the post-incident ticket and initial timeline.

ops-bot: monitor created: route-weight-history-panel (mon-id rw-233445) -> SUCCESS

incidents-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident tag: IN-2026-03-15-eun-cron-thundering.

elena garcia: timeline for postmortem: 11:07 cron started -> 11:08 KV latency spike -> 11:11 pager -> 11:14 traffic shift applied -> 11:22 cron paused & patch queued -> 11:35 p99 back below 700ms -> 11:40 stabilized.

kai wong: I'll open alert PR for combined condition + exclusion tag: https://repo.redwood/infra/alerts/pulls/629

tarun patel: brief note for runbook: add step to check scheduled crons and synth status before routing changes, and include an explicit check for large recompute jobs.

morgan lee: handing off to elena for customer comms draft and postmortem authoring. I'll continue to watch synth panels for next hour. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
